name: Censored for Betas
source: Censored for Betas takes place in a modern society where sexual interaction is strictly regulated until adulthood. On their 21st birthday, men undergo an evaluation that determines whether they fall above or below the so-called beta line. Those classified as betas are permanently censored: unable to view nudity or engage in sexual contact with women. The only way to bypass these restrictions is through a special request granted by a woman who feels the need to do so, allowing a beta to see and experience her body without strict limitations.
translation: 《Censored for Betas》发生在现代社会，性行为在成年之前都受到严格管制。在21岁生日那天，男性会接受一次评估，以确定他们是否高于或低于所谓的贝塔线。那些被归类为测试版的人会受到永久审查：无法观看裸体或与女性发生性接触。绕过这些限制的唯一方法是通过一位认为有必要这样做的女性提出的特殊请求，允许贝塔在没有严格限制的情况下看到和体验她的身体。
